description: Used inside a ScrollView or ListView to add pull-to-refresh functionality. When the ScrollView is at scrollY: 0, swiping down triggers an onRefresh event.

refreshing.description: Whether the view should be indicating an active refresh. Controlled prop.

onRefresh.description: Called when the view starts refreshing.

colors.description: The colors (at least one) that will be used to draw the refresh indicator.

enabled.description: Whether the pull-to-refresh functionality is enabled.

progressBackgroundColor.description: The background color of the refresh indicator.

tintColor.description: The color of the refresh indicator.

title.description: The title displayed under the refresh indicator.

titleColor.description: The color of the refresh indicator title.
